database_top_statements.query: update till_stock set on_hand = $1, reserved = $2, version = version + $6, updated_at = now() where sku = $3 and shard = $4 and version = $5
update till_reservation set state = $1, version = version + 1 where id = $2 and version = $3
select reservation_id, sku, shard, quantity from till_reservation_line where reservation_id = any($1) order by reservation_id, sku, shard

with target_lines as ( select sku, shard, quantity from till_reservation_line where reservation_id = $1), scope as ( select sku from unnest($2::varchar[]) as sku union select sku from target_lines) select kind, text1, text2, text3, int1, nu
insert into till_outbox (dedupe_key, payload, recorded_at) values ($1, $2, $3) on conflict (dedupe_key) do nothing
update till_outbox set published_at = $1 where sequence = any($2) and published_at is null
